dedupe_keys.name: wsabrazil wastewater management and household infrastructure in brazil

description: wsabrazil packages Brazilian household water and sanitation information from the 2010 Demographic Census atlas. The openwashdata authors provide 192,896 observations and 33 variables, including census-sector and municipality identifiers, household counts, average income, piped-water access, alternative water sources and sanitation outlets. The resource is intended to make household infrastructure data easier to analyse. Coverage is national, with administrative identifiers that can support spatial joins; the README does not establish a single geometric resolution. The census describes 2010, while the package citation is dated 2026. An R package, CSV and XLSX copies are publicly available in GitHub under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. A key caveat is that the README interprets sector_type as a binary housing-condition indicator without an inspected source-codebook check. That interpretation should not be used as a validated poverty measure. Simulation uses include allocating water-service demand and constructing household service-access scenarios. The data can complement data-worldpop-global-gridded-population after careful spatial and temporal reconciliation. It does not describe pipe connectivity or current water-network operations.
name: wsabrazil: wastewater management and household infrastructure in Brazil
notes: G8; G8-0010. The README attributes data to the IBGE 2010 census atlas. Its binary interpretation of sector_type is preserved as an unverified source claim, not adopted as a reliable housing-quality measure. Metadata only; no census rows downloaded.  Cited as: Götschmann, M.; Santos, L.; Schöbitz, L. (2026). wsabrazil: Wastewater management and household infrastructure in Brazil. Version 0.1.0. https://github.com/openwashdata/wsabrazil..
